interactions.assay: surface plasmon resonance (SPR) · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: The affinity of the epitope-specific mAb EP6b_B01 for binding the Fas extracellular domain (ECD) was determined by surface plasmon resonance. Antibody EP6b_B01 showed a 49-fold increase in affinity compared to the parent antibody E09. The improved affinity was due to a faster on-rate (3.4-fold) and a slower off-rate (14-fold).
